questions.question: Which Indian state launched the first Tribal Genome Sequencing Project?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is ​__**Gujarat**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Gujarat launches India’s first tribal genome project to tackle inherited diseases.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
Gujarat is the first Indian state to launch a Tribal Genome Sequencing Project.

 
 
• 
 
The goal is to enhance healthcare for tribal communities using genetic research.

 
 
• 
 
It targets early detection of hereditary diseases like sickle cell anaemia and thalassemia.

 
 
• 
 
The Gujarat Biotechnology Research Centre (GBRC) is leading the project.

 
 
• 
 
2,000 tribal individuals will have their genomes sequenced.

 
 
• 
 
The data will be used to build a reference genome database.

 
 
• 
 
This initiative supports the development of personalised medicine.

 
 
• 
 
It will also enable more effective, targeted treatments for tribal populations.

questions.question: Which city ranked as the most liveable in the Global Liveability Index 2025?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Copenhagen**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• World’s most liveable city for 2025 revealed.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
The **Economist Intelligence Unit (EIU)** released the **Global Liveability Index 2025**, ranking **173 cities**.

 
 
• 
 
The index evaluates cities on **30 indicators** across **five categories**:

 
 
• 
 
**Stability**

 
 
• 
 
**Healthcare**

 
 
• 
 
**Culture & Environment**

 
 
• 
 
**Education**

 
 
• 
 
**Infrastructure**

 
 
 
 
• 
 
Cities are scored from **1 (worst)** to **100 (best)**.

 
 
• 
 
**Copenhagen (Denmark)** is the **most liveable city** in 2025 (score: **98/100**).

 
 
• 
 
**Zurich (Switzerland)** and **Vienna (Austria)** tied for **2nd place** (97.1/100).

 
 
• 
 
**Copenhagen** achieved **perfect scores** in **stability, education, and infrastructure**, ending Vienna’s 3-year streak at the top.

 
 
• 
 
**Least liveable cities**:

 
 
• 
 
**Damascus (Syria)** – 30.7/100

 
 
• 
 
**Tripoli (Libya)** – 40.1/100

 
 
• 
 
**Dhaka (Bangladesh)** – 41.7/100

 
 
 
 
• 
 
**India’s performance**:

 
 
• 
 
**Delhi** and **Mumbai** both scored **60.2**, ranked **141st** out of 173.

questions.question: What was the name of the counterterror operation in which Pahalgam attack mastermind killed?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Operation Mahadev**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Op Mahadev: Terrorist believed to be Pahalgam attack mastermind, 2 others killed in encounter near Srinagar.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Operation Mahadev**: A joint counterterrorism operation by the **Indian Army** and **J&K Police** in **Srinagar**.

 
 
• 
 
**Three Pakistani terrorists** were killed in the **Dachigam area near Mount Mahadev**, Srinagar.

 
 
• 
 
Among them was **Suleiman Shah alias Musa Fauji**, a **top Lashkar-e-Taiba commander**.

 
 
• 
 
He was the **mastermind and executor** of the **Pahalgam terror attack**, which killed **26 civilians**.

 
 
• 
 
The name **“Mahadev”** was derived from the **Zabarwan–Mahadev ridgeline** near the encounter site.
